Title: Import catalog - product description lands in the default language
Preconditions: CSV in the export format with a product row carrying a description and a StartDate (a row with an empty StartDate is silently skipped, KB-6891B496); the target catalog has 2 or more languages, otherwise 'no variants in other languages' proves nothing; the catalog default language is known
Steps:
1. Open the Import blade and open Map columns for the CSV
2. Verify there is no language column or language mapping target for descriptions
3. Import a CSV row with a description for a new AGENT-TEST- product
4. Open the product and read its description in the catalog default language
5. Open the same product in another catalog language
References: C256728 | Repaired 2026-10-14 (Stable 16 regression VCST-6042): CSV format has no language column and the VirtoOZ import guide documents none, so multilanguage descriptions cannot be imported; retargeted to the supported behaviour (description lands in the default language, once). Catches: description dropped, duplicated or written to a wrong language

Title: Import - property values carry no language mapping and are imported once
Preconditions: CSV in the export format with a product row carrying a value for a catalog property
Steps:
1. Import a CSV with a property value column for a new AGENT-TEST- product
2. On the mapping blade check the property column's mapping targets
3. Complete the import
4. Open the product and read the property value
References: C256726 | Repaired 2026-10-14 (Stable 16 regression VCST-6042): no per-language column/mapping for property values exists in the CSV module, so multilanguage property values cannot be imported; retargeted to the supported behaviour (single value imported once). Catches: value lost or duplicated
